An '''astromech droid''' resided on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trevura]]<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20020411a|text=Gun Nut|int=Gun Nut}}</ref> at some point between [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="Date">"[[Gun Nut]]" is set in the [[Rebellion era|Rebellion Era]], which {{Blog|holocron|24|Star Wars Eras}} dates to between [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref>

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The astromech droid was created for "[[Gun Nut]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] miniadventure for the [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Jeff Quick]] and published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[April 11]], [[2002]].<ref name="Wizards" />
